title: Do Role-Playing Agents Practice What They Preach? Belief-Behavior Consistency in LLM-Based Simulations of Human Trust
reasoning: The paper evaluates the consistency of LLMs when role-playing personas with specific religious affiliations (e.g., Catholic, Protestant, etc.) and moral values (e.g., fairness, reciprocity, prudence). It explicitly includes 'Religion' as a trait in its evaluation framework and analyzes how these beliefs and value systems influence simulated behavioral outcomes and reasoning in the Trust Game.
